Use: HOST TESTS ONLY. kernel64/host/test_virgl_enc.c compares the independently written constants and packet layout of
win64/include/shzvirgl.h with virgl_protocol.h / virgl_hw.h; kernel64/host/test_virgl_exec.c uses virglrenderer.h to
call the host library. Nothing here is compiled into the guest kernel or the Win64 DLLs.
tests/test_virtio_host.py re-hashes these files and fails if they no longer match the table above.
